340 Palos Verdes Drive West

AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85719586756
Zoom Meeting ID: 857 1958 6756
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 857 1958 6756#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.

Recommendation: Receive and File.

Recommendation: Receive and File

5.
Approval of a Memorandum of Understanding Between the Palos Verdes Peninsula Group for Cost-Sharing of Revision of the Enhanced Watershed Management Program (EWMP) and Reasonable Assurance Analysis (RAA)
Recommendation: Approve and authorize execution of the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Rancho Palos Verdes, the City of Palos Verdes Estates, the City of Rolling Hills Estates, and the County of Los Angeles (Peninsula EWMP Agencies) regarding the Administration and Cost Sharing for Revision of the Enhanced Watershed Management Program and Reasonable Assurance Analysis for the Peninsula EWMP Agencies (EWMP Revision MOU) subject to minor modifications as approved by the City Attorney and City Manager
Staff Report

Provision of Financial Information to the City Council in Accordance with State Government Code Section 41004 and City Municipal Code Section 2.10.020(E)
Recommendation: Receive and File Financial Statements for the Month of February 2021.
Staff Report
7.
Approval of an Agreement with Liebert, Cassidy, Whitmore (LCW) for Special Legal Services
Recommendation: (1) waive the procedures set forth in PVEMC Section 3.24.60 to fit this specific purchase as allowed under PVEMC Section 3.24.100, and (2) approve the proposed agreement with Liebert Cassidy Whitmore (LCW) for special legal services subject to funding available.
Staff Report
8.
Approval and Authorization to Submit to the Los Angeles County Flood Control District of the FY2021/22 Annual Plan for Safe, Clean Water Municipal Program Expenditures
Recommendation: Approve and authorize staff to submit the City of Palos Verdes Estates Safe Clean Water Municipal Program Annual Plan for Expenditures in Fiscal Year 2021/22 (SCW Annual Plan FY2021/22) to the Los Angeles County Flood Control District (District) in order to receive payment of the City’s share of annual funds under the Safe Clean Water Program (Measure W).
Staff Report
9.
Consideration of a Resolution to Oppose AB377 (Rivas)
Recommendation: 1) Adopt resolution 21-15 opposing AB 377 (Rivas); and 2) Authorize the Mayor, on behalf of the City Council, to join the other peninsula cities and sign a joint letter of opposition to AB 377.
Staff Report
10.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: Accept the donations as presented and thank the donors for their generosity.
Staff Report

Recommendation: Receive and File.

NEW BUSINESS
12.
Presentation of the Results of and Receipt and Filing of the Annual Audit and the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Period Ending June 30, 2020 (Fiscal Year 2019/2020)
Recommendation: Receive a report of the results of the annual audit and receive and file the accompanying Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the period ending June 30, 2020 (Fiscal Year 2019/2020).
Staff Report
13.
Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Expansion Project – Phasing Options
Recommendation: Provide Staff Direction in order to expedite improvements to the Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Expansion Project, including improvements to the Palos Verdes Drive West/Via Corta intersection.
Staff Report
14.
Termination of the Current License Agreement for the use of George Allen Field, Consideration of the Peninsula Junior League Baseball's Alternative Use Proposal, and Write Off of Unpaid Debt.
Recommendation: 1) Terminate the current license agreement for the use of George Allen Field; 2) Consider Peninsula Junior League Baseball's alternative proposal; 3) Write off some or all of the unpaid debt; and 4) Provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, April 13, 2021 AT 6:30 P.M.
i.

Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk

MINUTES
  OF THE MARCH 23, 2021 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom
pursuant to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020,
was called to order by Mayor Kemps at 6:31 P.M. on March 23, 2021, notice having been
given with affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following
information to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85719586756
  Zoom Meeting ID: 857 1958 6756
  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 857 1958 6756#
  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R21-15

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O21-748

CALL TO ORDER 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT: Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tem Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
Murdock

ALSO PRESENT:
City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Greenberg, Acting Police Chief Best,
Community Development Director Rindge, City Support Services Director Hannah, City Clerk
Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tem Lozzi, seconded by Councilmember McGowan to approve
the agenda.
AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
NOES: None

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Mayor Kemps reported on the joint Planning Commission meeting with the Palos Verdes Homes
Association. He noted current agenda items and their relation to increasing demands resulting
from State legislation regarding local control over housing and the impact on the City’s financial
position.
Mayor Kemps mentioned a Special Meeting on April 6th to review and discuss City infrastructure
needs and an update on the Pension Ad Hoc Committee recommendations for the April 13th City
Council meeting. He also provided a reminder on the upcoming bulky items and compost events.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
MARCH 23, 2021
 City Manager Guglielmo reported on the recent Blood Drive and Paper Shredding events. She
provided a general update on the American Rescue Plan Act and noted that staff will prepare a
report for the City Council once more information is available. She provided local community
updates related to Covid-19 guidelines and reopening.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

The following individuals addressed the City Council: Valerie Gorsuch, Nancy Robson, and
Desiree Myers.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 – 10)

ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, seconded by Councilmember Murdock to
approve the consent agenda.
AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
NOES: None

  a.  March 9, 2021 Special Meeting Minutes
  b.  March 9, 2021 Regular Meeting Minutes

  Understanding between the City of Rancho Palos Verdes, the City of Palos Verdes

 8.  Approval and Authorization to Submit to the Los Angeles County Flood Control

OLD BUSINESS

11.  Annual Housing Element Progress Report

  Community Development Director Rindge reported.

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

NEW BUSINESS

12.  Presentation of the Results of and Receipt and Filing of the Annual Audit and the
  Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Period Ending June 30, 2020
  (Fiscal Year 2019/2020)

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  City Support Services Director Hannah and Daphnie Munoz from CLA presented.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Councilmember
  McGowan to (1) Receive a report of the results of the annual audit for the year
  ended June 30, 2020; and (2)  Receive  and  file  the  accompanying
  Comprehensive Annual Financial Report, ACL Conclusion, GAS Letter, and Gann

13.  Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Expansion Project – Phasing Options

  Tim Jonasson and Rob Olson of HR Green presented.

  Valerie Gorsuch addressed the City Council.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, seconded by Councilmember Roos
  to have Metro revise the draft funding agreement to move forward with Project
  Approval/Environmental Documentation and Plans, Specifications & Estimates for

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
MARCH 23, 2021
   the Palos Verdes Drive West/ Via Corta intersection as Phase 1 of the Palos Verdes
  Drive West Corridor Expansion Project.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

14.  Termination of the Current License Agreement for the use of George Allen Field,
  Consideration of the Peninsula Junior League Baseball’s Alternative Use
  Proposal, and Write Off of Unpaid Debt.

  Recommendation: 1) Terminate the current license agreement for the use of George
  Allen Field; 2) Consider Peninsula Junior League Baseball’s alternative proposal; 3)
  Write off some or all of the unpaid debt; and 4) Provide direction to staff.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, seconded by Councilmember McGowan
  to instruct the City Attorney to draft an agreement with the Peninsula Junior League,
  accepting their proposal as written, through 2022 at $6,000 per year, and a $10,000
  payment for past due utilities due within 10 days of contract execution, to be approved
  at the next City Council meeting.
  AYES: Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES: None

MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
